name: tablet-ipad-mobile-ua
deviceClass: iPad Air (M1), browser that sends the iPad user agent token
source: Same hardware as tablet-ipad but the user agent carries the iPad token, as a browser sends when mobile sites are requested. Safari has no navigator.userAgentData and no navigator.deviceMemory. hardwareConcurrency and adapter values are unmeasured; GPU limits are the WebGPU specification default limits (the floor every adapter must meet), not a measurement of this device.
